Axiom: Every fix routes through the task that owns the affected file — ownership is resolved from the artifacts, before classification. `@tasks: -[, ...]` in a file header names the owning task(s). Files matching `*.task.-.md` (co-located under `specs/`) are tickets — the Task-ID is in the filename. Files matching `*.1-spec.md` / `*.spec.md` are spec files — linked to a scope, not a single task. Index files (`*.2-tasks.md` / `*.3-tasks.md`, `specs/2-tasks.md` / `specs/3-tasks.md`) are global artifacts, owned by no task. The resulting file → [Task-IDs] map is what routes fixes per `AX_FIX_CLASSIFICATION`. A resolvable code owner is binding: every code finding routes to that ticket's new Round. Missing or ambiguous ownership does not mean "direct-fix"; recover/create a ticket, or route a semantic ownership gap through authoring first.
